limitations.quote: The final 0 of the match and this 1 start an overlapping match
limitations.note: The patch correctly preserves `s3_d011` on invalid cycles, but it also changes two transitions out of `s4_d0110` to allow overlapping matches where the original FSM and the reference fix return to `idle`.
The exhaustive test used a rolling history that expected overlapping detections, so it passed the extra behavior rather than checking that the original post-match transitions were preserved.
